beliefs: f returns its input unchanged for ordinary strings, including control chars, Unicode, combining marks, zero-width chars, and long strings [E1, E2, E3, E4]
f removes the exact substring 'BOM' (uppercase only) wherever it appears, leaving U+FEFF intact [E4, E5, E6]
f also removes 'Bom' (B-o-m) wherever it appears [E6]
f does NOT remove 'bOM', 'BoM', 'bOm', or 'bom' [E6, E7]
Removal matches exactly the set {'BOM','Bom','BOm'}: first char must be uppercase B, and the last two chars are either 'OM' or 'om' [E6, E7]
Removal is applied repeatedly/globally so adjacent copies are all removed, e.g. 'BOMBOMBOM'->'OMOMOM' and 'BBOM'->'OM' [E8]
Removal is non-overlapping left-to-right: 'BOMbOM'->'OMbOM' (the 'bOM' is not removed) [E8]
